run_text_generation: run conditional text generation with GPT-2, XLNet, or Transformer-XL models via CLI
filter_logits_top_k_top_p: filter a distribution of logits using top-k and nucleus (top-p) sampling strategies
sample_text_sequence: sample a text sequence autoregressively from a pre-trained language model with temperature and filtering
set_random_seed: set random seeds for numpy and torch reproducibility across CPU and GPU devices
generate_text_cli: generate text from a prompt using a specified transformer model type and path via argparse CLI
